scope: isolated local tests; mock SSH/systemd and deterministic clocks
checks: early events displayed immediately without warning
warning at deadline and no repeated warning until recovery
pending and empty journal do not silently wait forever
saved progress cursor bypasses a new startup grace
bad binding or malformed response warned immediately
temporary progress RPC/SSH failures honor grace
operation does not wait out grace after completion
same operation ID and no duplicate Ansible launch
operation execution timeout and SSH budgets unchanged
limitation: New startup wait is locally verified; no cloud acceptance was performed.
